posts.title: Parsing a past time from text in Swift
posts.description: A meal being logged already happened, so “pasta for dinner” typed at 08:00 means last night. How I parse typed times in Swift into the most recent past.

posts.title: SwiftUI not restoring the window size on macOS
posts.description: SwiftUI kept opening my Mac app at its default size instead of where I left it. The cause was a private ViewModifier at the window root; the fix was one word.

posts.title: App Store preview videos with Claude Code
posts.description: How to make an App Store preview video without recording the app: redraw it in code and encode it with ffmpeg. All built with Claude Code.
